state.background: Plan45 Phase 2 Batch 2 has migrated roster positions 21–40 (20 partial scenarios) to Vitest Browser Mode against the production Next route. The route runner executes Chromium and a dedicated WebKit config against the same production server. The batch covers year-range URL/data contracts, section-tab scroll geometry across engines, spending legend filters, tooltip Escape and stack-total/rehover behavior, mobile touch/viewport acceptance, and 320/375/390px chart readability geometry. The B2-mapped E2E predicates were removed only after matching Browser Mode coverage was added. T8 in tooltip-stack-total.e2e.spec.ts was removed entirely after its predicates moved. A separate final audit found three out-of-scope B4 assertions had been removed; those exact earnings-tooltip label/total assertions and the scrolled-tooltip hidden assertion were restored, and their roster rows remain pending.

The production-route suite, focused existing Browser Mode suites, lint, and full E2E complete successfully.

state.outputRequirement: Choose one listed choice. For a reason choice, give a case-specific finding, affected location or requirement, observed verification evidence, and either a concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent details.

implementation.instructions: Does the supplied evidence support acceptance as defined for Batch 2? Return a probability distribution over the listed choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The supplied evidence supports acceptance as defined.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: Requirements conflict with intended behavior; identify the requirement and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Prerequisite information is missing; identify exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: Implementation information is incomplete; identify missing details or evidence.
criteria.implementation_issue: An implementation issue exists; identify its location, evidence, and correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The proposal exceeds or falls outside the agreed scope; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit the categories; identify its location, evidence, and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a judgment; identify missing context if possible.
